spans.s:
लवः [लू-अप्]
1 Plucking,
mowing.
--2 Reaping, gathering (of
corn).
--3 A section, piece, fragment,
bit.
--4 A particle, drop, small
quantity; a little; oft. at the end
of comp. in this sense; जललवमुचः

; so तृण˚,
अपराध˚, ज्ञान˚, सुख˚, धन˚ &c. &c.
--5 Wool, hair.
--6 Sport.
--7 A
minute division of time (=the
sixth part of a twinkling).
--8 The
numerator of a fraction.
--9 A
degree (in astr.).
--10 Loss,
destruction.
--11 N. of a son of
Rāma, one of the twins, the other
being Kuśa q. v. He with his
brother was brought up by the
sage Vālmīki, and they were
taught by the poet to repeat his
Rāmāyaṇa at assemblies &c.; (for
the derivation of his name, see

).
--12 A kind of quail.
--वं
1 Cloves.
--2 Nutmeg.
--वं ind. A
little; लवमपि लवंगे न रमते Sar.

लवण a. [लू-ल्युट् पृषो˚ णत्वम्]
1
Saline, saltish, briny.
--2 Lovely,
handsome.
--णः
1 Saline taste.
--2
The sea of salt water.
--3 N. of a
demon, son of Madhu, who was
killed by Śatrughna;

.
--4 N. of a hell.
--णं
1
Salt sea-salt.
--2 A factitious
salt.
--Comp.
--अंतकः an
epithet of Śatrughna.
--अब्धिः the
salt ocean. ˚जं sea-salt.
--अंबुराशिः
the ocean; आभाति वेला लवणांबुराशेः

. (--n.)
salt water.
--आकरः {1} a salt-mine.
{2} a receptacle of salt water; i. e.
the sea. {3} (fig.) a mine of beauty.
--आलयः the ocean.
--उत्तमं {1}
rocksalt. {2} nitre.
--रुदः {1} the ocean.
{2} the sea of salt water.
--उदकः, --उदधिः, --जलः &c. the ocean.
[]
--क्षारं a kind of salt.
--जलोद्भवः a
muscle, shell.
--मेहः a kind of
urinary disease.
--समुद्रः the salt-sea, the
ocean.

लावण a. (णी f.) [लवणे संस्कृतं
अण्]
1 Salt.
--2 Salted, dressed with
salt.

लवणयति Den. P. To salt, season
with salt.
लवणस्यति Den. P. To wish for salt.

लवणिमन् m.
1 Saltness.
--2
Beauty, loveliness, grace.

लवनं [लू भावे कर्मणि च ल्युट्]
1
Mowing, cutting, reaping (of corn
&c.).
--2 An instrument for mowing,
a sickle, scythe.

लवली A kind of creeper; मया
लब्धः पाणिर्ललितलवलीकंदलानिभः

1 A sickle, a reaping
instrument.
--2 The act of cutting or
mowing.

1 A cutter, divider.
--2 A
reaper, gatherer.
--3 A quail;
[]
योध्यंते लावकाः

लावाणकः N. of a district near
Magadha.

लवित्रं An instrument for
mowing, a sickle.

.
--2 Plucking,
gathering.
--3 Cutting down,
killing, destroying;

लावणिक a. (की f.) [लवणे संस्कृतं
ठण्]
1 Salted, dressed with salt.
--2 Dealing in salt.
--3 Lovely,
beautiful, charming; लीलयैव
सुतनोस्तुलयित्वा गौरवाढ्यमपि लावणिकेन
Śi. 10. 38 (where it means ‘a
saltmerchant’ also).
--कः A
salt-merchant.
--कं A salt-vessel, salt-cellar.

लावण्यं [लवणस्य भावः ष्यञ्]
1
Saltness.
--2 Beauty, loveliness, charm;
तथापि तस्या लावण्यं रेखया किंचिदन्वितं
Ś. 6. 13; 7. 18; (लावण्य is thus
defined in Śabdak:
--मुक्ताफलेषु
छायायास्तरलत्वमिवांतरा । प्रतिभाति यदंगेषु
तल्लावण्यमिहोच्यते ॥).
--Comp.
--अर्जितं the
private property of a married woman
given to her at her marriage by her
father or mother-in-law.
